name: order_liver_biopsy
description: Orders a liver biopsy (percutaneous, transjugular, or laparoscopic) for histopathological evaluation. Used to stage and grade chronic liver diseases, evaluate unexplained liver enzyme elevations, diagnose storage diseases, and assess liver transplant rejection.

studies_requested.description: Additional studies (iron stain, copper stain, trichrome, PAS, immunohistochemistry)

when_to_use: Staging of chronic hepatitis B or C
Evaluation of liver transplant rejection or dysfunction
Suspected hepatic steatosis, fibrosis, or cirrhosis

examples.query: Percutaneous liver biopsy for autoimmune hepatitis

args.clinical_indication: elevated transaminases with positive ANA and smooth muscle antibody
